Corrigendum for Tender Notice – 26
Wednesday, 15 March 2017
11013 Hits
The corrigendum for the Tender Notice - 26 (2016-17) is being published with the respect to the following for which the technical specifications are revised.
Article No. 3 i.e. Wireless Controller with Access points
The tender forms with revised specifications will be available in the office of the Dean (Central Purchase Section) on working days between 10.00 am and 4.00 pm. Tender forms with revised specifications can also be obtained by sending email to ‘
centralstore@mgims.ac.in
’ or can be downloaded from the institute website (www.mgims.ac.in).
The last date of submission of tender and other terms and conditions remain same as in the original tender notice - 26 (2016-17). The Dean reserves the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason.
Corrigendum for Tender Document C
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
